gui.useless_core.font.title: Font Settings
gui.useless_core.font.family_hint: Click to cycle font families. Script uses script.ttf or an installed calligraphy font. Enter a file name below for custom fonts.
gui.useless_core.font.shadow_hint: Toggle text drop shadows. Off by default to avoid offset ghosting; bold remains independent.
gui.useless_core.font.color_hint: Choose a swatch or enter #RRGGBB. Ordinary text defaults to black; explicit rarity and warning colors are preserved.
gui.useless_core.font.invalid_color: Enter six hexadecimal digits, for example #000000
gui.useless_core.font.size_hint: Size 6-16, default 9; click here to restore 9
gui.useless_core.font.reset_pending: Defaults restored; click Apply to use them
gui.useless_core.font.format_hint: Styles preview live; apply family changes. Large fonts may exceed fixed controls.
gui.useless_core.font.default_hint: Use the original game and resource pack fonts
gui.useless_core.font.file_hint: Select Custom, then enter a file name such as custom.ttf. The TTF / TTC file must be in the font folder.
gui.useless_core.font.fallback: Apply to preview; missing characters use the original fonts
gui.useless_core.font.failed: Font could not load; the Minecraft font remains available
gui.useless_core.font.save_failed: Could not save font settings; check the config directory
